nodes.prompt: Hi {{app_user}}! What would you like to do?

nodes.intro: Let me help you with your leave application.
nodes.goal: Help {{app_user}} prepare a leave request. First check their balance with get_leave_balance and read the leave_policy skill. Then collect the leave type, the first day, the number of working days and a short reason, asking one question at a time. Check the request against the policy and the balance, explain any problem, and call finish when everything is valid. Do not book anything yourself: the user submits the request afterwards.

outputs.name: reason
outputs.label: Reason
outputs.description: Short reason; required for unpaid leave

exits.name: main_menu
exits.description: the user wants to do something else

nodes.errorMessage: Sorry, the assistant couldn't finish this.

nodes.text: Here's your leave request. Please check it:
Request {{reference}} is submitted. Your manager will review it.

nodes.goal: Book leave for {{app_user}}. Check the balance with get_leave_balance and read the leave_policy skill. Ask for anything missing (leave type, first day, working days, and a reason for unpaid leave). When the request is valid, call book_leave; the user is asked to confirm it. When book_leave succeeds, call finish with its reference. If the user cancels, ask whether to change something or stop.

exits.name: main_menu
exits.description: the user wants to stop or do something else

nodes.goal: Answer {{app_user}}'s questions about their leave. Use get_leave_balance and list_my_leave, keep answers short, and ask if there is anything else. When they are done, call finish. If they want to apply for leave, hand off to apply.

exits.name: apply
exits.description: the user wants to apply for leave

nodes.text: Please use the leave form, or contact HR.
